body.message:
Total Rental Amount:

We confirm that the total rental amount of AED 20,000 for the full 90-night stay is fixed and will remain unchanged, provided the agreed payment schedule is followed.

Relocation to Another Property:

In the event that relocation is required due to the apartment being sold, returned to the owner, or for maintenance-related reasons, we confirm that your agreed rental rate will remain the same and will not be adjusted according to seasonal pricing.

DEWA Consumption:

Please do not worry, there will be no additional charges applied for DEWA (water and electricity) consumption during your stay.

Security Deposit Refund:
The AED 2,000 security deposit will be fully refunded within the stated timeframe, provided there is no damage to the property and no outstanding charges upon check-out.

We hope the above clarifications provide you with the required confirmation. Please feel free to proceed with signing the agreement, and we will be happy to assist you with the next steps.

Thank you.
